purpose: One staged CAST up-chain/down-chain task array: ground-zero machine resources to Ubuntu Codespaces human studio, then verify the whole chain back to ground zero.
sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

targetStudio.role: headless editable studio, source builds, private candidate renders, supervised polish

tasks.target: Current Codespaces compute allocation and physical-device separation
evidence: live Codespace identifier and provider-hosted CPU/RAM/disk receipt
disk free and memory headroom measured on current runtime
GPU capability explicitly reported as available or unavailable, not guessed
network and restart/persistence limits recorded
tasks.next: Read actual Codespace resource and hardware evidence; if inaccessible, mark UNKNOWN and continue independent source checks.

evidence: Codespace image build and exact source digest
actual /etc/os-release plus provider-kernel boundary
codespace user, private forwarded ports, database socket-only rules
codespace startup/stop and credential boundary receipt
tasks.next: Run or obtain current Codespaces smoke receipt without exposing SSH, databases, secrets or ports.

evidence: installed executable versions and real smoke output from Codespace
npm locked build and read-only CAST refusal tests
MCP read-only handoff and headless Godot/media asset proof
private MariaDB runtime separately verified if needed, never inferred from package install
tasks.next: Verify exact-head npm and Python CI, then distinguish source/build evidence from actual Codespace tool execution.

tasks.target: Human-directed Ubuntu Codespaces creative studio and CAST staging integration
evidence: actual headless edit/render/import command and resulting candidate hash
original-media rights/provenance and Drive-backed source protected
plugin Godot/Three demo builds traceable to exact source
reviewable human-facing cockpit, studio action, rollback and one-use CAST eligibility evidence
tasks.next: Polish one representative reversible studio scene and review output; don't claim polished live cast or ChatGPT mount without device and host acceptance.

tasks.target: Verify the deployed artifact chain is identical to reviewed toolchain output
evidence: exact checked-in source SHA and artifact SHA256 matched to deployment receipt
Render service revision and actual MCP response matched (not only HTTP 200)
no unapproved Node backend, duplicate JavaScript engine or mutable CDN dependency
reproducible rollback source, scoped task and independent negative controls
tasks.next: Compare candidate hashes with current target runtime; keep live deployment and device proof UNVERIFIED until real receipts exist.

tasks.target: Verify every production-facing path honors trust and authority boundaries
evidence: secret absence in browser/client/build outputs
Codespaces port forwarding private and MariaDB socket-only
MCP authority readOnly; no silent worker, merge, DNS or signing promotion
human approval and one-use CAST scoped to exact source and single task
tasks.next: Recheck network, permission, trust and rollback refusal controls from output toward operating-system boundary.

tasks.target: Ground-zero replay, capacity, recoverability and physical acceptance
evidence: repeatable cold-start Codespace bootstrap on approved source
measured CPU/RAM/disk/runtime compatibility without invented GPU
private assets preserved and rollback/recovery verified
separately recorded Samsung touch and ChatGPT widget acceptance, or explicit pending blocker
tasks.next: Review ground-zero recovery and remaining device/host proof; report final staging verdict and exactly one owner action if necessary.
